fact: The head of CAPMAS said on 28 August 2023 that most of rural Egypt has almost no building numbering or streets, and that numbering and addressing of all buildings and land nationwide is targeted within 3 years.
title: رئيس جهاز الإحصاء: نستهدف الانتهاء من الترقيم والعنونة على مستوى الجمهورية خلال 3 سنوات
